title: Triangles and values
info: In a right triangle, sin = opposite/hypotenuse, cos = adjacent/hypotenuse, and tan = opposite/adjacent.
cosec A is 1/sin A. The greatest value of sin θ is 1.

questions.q: tan θ = 3/4. What is the hypotenuse of the right triangle with opposite side 3 and adjacent side 4?
sin A = 1/2. What is cosec A?
What is the greatest value of sin θ?
questions.explain: Sine is always between −1 and 1, so its greatest value is 1.

questions.q: sin θ = 0. What is tan θ? (Take θ = 0°.)
questions.explain: sin 0° = 0 and tan 0° = 0. Also tan θ = sin θ / cos θ = 0/1 = 0.

questions.q: sin θ = 6/7 and θ is acute. What is cos θ?
questions.explain: Opposite side 6, hypotenuse 7. Adjacent side = √(7² − 6²) = √(49 − 36) = √13. cos θ = √13/7.
